items.title: Buzzy Williams Interview, 1980-06-18
items.q: Jimmy Cooper told me, says, if you quit going to New York, play for Tommy Lyman, I'll fix that room up.

ctx.x: Well maybe Lee Kelly come into the Court of Two Sisters when Tony and I was working in the courtyard place, I don't know what they... What was it called?
Huh? That room we were in. Jimmy Cooper built that little place in the back. You're talking about the place on Bourbon? Yeah.
The Court Tavern. The Court Tavern, that's right.
